subject: Recap: Renewal & expansion call — usage review + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Renewal & expansion call — usage review + next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and the recommended next steps so we have shared alignment heading into your exec review next week.

Key takeaways / pain points you shared:
- Cost pressure across inference workloads, especially for bursty nightly jobs and larger-context generations for search.
- Need better predictability for monthly spend to satisfy procurement and forecasting.
- Interest in a dedicated pool for the recommendations team to reduce tail latency for interactive tooling.

Current usage snapshot (June 2026):
- Hosted API: ~1.2B tokens/month (mainly embeddings + chat), 60% of tokens from nightly batch jobs.
- Peak qps: ~45 reqs/s; p50 latency 90ms, p95 420ms on publicly hosted endpoints.

Recommended expansion path:
1) Move "recommendations" workload to a Redwood Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) with a 2x headroom burst policy to cover peak traffic — improves p95 latency and gives predictable unit pricing.
2) Configure prefix/KV caching for nightly batch runs to reduce duplicate token costs.
3) Adopt the quantization profile we discussed for the embedding model to reduce GPU memory and enable an additional replica for throughput.

Business asks / timeline:
- You mentioned exec review on 28 Jul. If we can deliver a pricing options packet and a proposed SOW by 23 Jul, you should be able to include it in that meeting.
- Procurement needs a rough monthly commitment number to evaluate.

Next steps (owner / due):
- Marissa: Send pricing options + SOW draft (attached) — target 23 Jul.
- Rishi: Prep Dedicated sizing estimate and expected latency improvements — target 22 Jul.
- Monica (CS): Prepare QBR deck and usage report for June (attached).
- Alex: Confirm timing of your exec slot and any additional stakeholders to loop in.

Attachments included: QBR-deck-Jul2026.pdf, usage_report_Jun2026.csv (see links below).

If I missed anything or you want me to emphasize different metrics for procurement, let me know and I can adjust the packet.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

---
Quoted for context (call notes):
> On Tue, Jul 20, 2026 at 15:00 Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com> wrote:
> > Thanks for the overview today — excited to see the latency improvements.
> > Will share with procurement and the recommendations lead.

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Renewal & expansion call — usage review + next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Confirming the points below so procurement has what they need:
- We're interested in the Dedicated pool for the recommendations workload (likely Q4 ramp).
- Need a committed monthly spend range (min / target / max) and a short explanation of the burst policy.
- Can you include an option that keeps embeddings on hosted with a cross-charge vs fully dedicated embeddings? Procurement likes to see hybrid options.

Our exec review is scheduled for Wed, 28 Jul at 10:00am PT. I should have procurement's initial feedback by Mon, 26 Jul.

Also looping in Procurement so they can flag any legal or term requests early.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Data Platforms, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Renewal & expansion call — usage review + next steps

Alex —

Thanks — attached are two options: a) Hybrid (embeddings hosted + Dedicated for recommendations) and b) Full Dedicated (all inference on Dedicated). Each option includes committed monthly ranges and estimated cost delta vs your current bill. See pricing_options_v2.pdf.

I've also attached a short SOW draft (SOW-draft-Acme.pdf) that outlines deliverables, a proposed kickoff, and milestones aligned to your Q4 ramp. Rishi's sizing estimate is embedded in the SOW; he flagged that with current token growth we'd recommend capacity for ~1.8B tokens/month initially with autoscale rules.

Proposed timeline:
- 23 Jul: Finalize pricing packet (this email) — complete.
- 26 Jul: Procurement feedback (you) — target.
- 28 Jul: Exec review at 10:00am PT (you).
- 05 Aug: Target signature / PO submission (if exec approves).
- 15 Aug: Kickoff and onboarding session with Monica/CS.

Action items:
- Alex: Share any procurement redlines or legal questions (by 26 Jul).
- Procurement: If helpful, we can provide a short procurement summary that calls out SLAs, data controls, and termination terms.
- Rishi: I'll coordinate a short tech deep-dive session after signature to finalize sizing.

If that timeline looks good, I'll prep the DocuSign package once procurement confirms the preferred option.

Best,

Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: pricing_options_v2.pdf, SOW-draft-Acme.pdf
